title: 第20章 又来一笔意外之财
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
翌日，花期难得睡了个懒觉。

    因为不用干活，不用上班，加上又劳累了两天，她躺在床上睡到十点才醒。

    小花贴切地端着一个餐盘进屋，放在花期随手能够到的地方。

    “主人您醒了，我们今日的早餐是芝士凤梨牛肉汉堡，是麦麦家的新品。”

    “不过我没抢到九块九的秒杀早餐，这一餐一共花费二十五。”

    花期抻懒腰的动作一顿，偏头望着床头柜上还冒着热气的汉堡和牛奶。

    “小花，你不用特意给我禀告，我给你授权的时候说过，一切按照你认为正确的程序决定。”

    “好的主人，小花明白。”

    生活机器人的屏幕跳出两个笑眯眯的眼睛，“主人您快尝尝，这款汉堡星网评价味道不错，能达到九十分。”

    “那我尝尝。”

    花期打开床上的小桌板，将餐盘端在自己面前，用热毛巾擦了擦手，就坐在床上直接吃早餐。

    她一边吃，小花一边在旁边汇报今日的计划。

    “在您睡觉的这段时间，外面送来了许多快递，我已经全部签收归位。”

    “其中您购买的衣物有十件，花国民国时期的布鞋二十双，一箱蚕丝线，一箱产自鲛人星球的珍珠，以及您特意叮嘱的云纱也送来了。”

    “鲛人星的快递到了？”

    花期猛然抬眸，放下汉堡端起牛奶一饮而尽，匆忙跑出卧室来到客厅。

    一间比外面会客厅偏小的客厅内，三个大箱子正放在茶几正中间。

    花期带着激动的心情，打开了第一个泡沫箱。

    以白色为主，紫色为辅，粉红色居中的一大箱子珍珠静静躺在盒子里。

    花期呼吸一滞，随便拿起一串白色珍珠项链，摸着光滑的手感以及堪比大拇指盖一样的规模，心头受了不小的震撼。

    还得是在原产地进货，种类和品质丝毫不输于蓝星上的澳白珍珠。

    这么一大箱子珍珠，她才只花了几百星际币。

    这要是搁老家，一颗珍珠都不止几百。

    花期轻轻把珍珠放回箱子，又看向另外两箱。

    蚕丝线和她预料的就有点差距，光泽不行，手感也有点粗糙，远没有真丝的丝滑度。

    现在星际的养蚕手段虽然很规模化，但每一只蚕宝宝吃的都是速成营养液，吐出来的蚕丝也不怎么好。
content_en:
The next day, I had a rare sleep during the flowering period.

    Because she didn't have to work or go to work, and she was tired for two days, she lay in bed and slept until ten o'clock.

    Xiao Hua thoughtfully carried a dinner plate into the house and placed it somewhere within easy reach of Flower Period.

    "Master, you're awake. Our breakfast today is cheese pineapple beef burger, which is a new product from MaiMai's family."

    "But I didn't get the flash sale breakfast for ninety-nine yuan. This meal cost twenty-five yuan in total."

    Hua Qi stretched her waist and turned her head to look at the steaming burgers and milk on the bedside table.

    "Xiao Hua, you don't have to go out of your way to report it to me. I said when I gave you the authorization, everything will be decided according to the procedures you think are correct."

    "Okay master, Xiaohua understands."

    Two smiling eyes popped up on the screen of the life robot, "Master, try it quickly. This burger has a good taste and can reach 90 points."

    "Then let me try it."

    Huaqi opened the small table on the bed, put the dinner plate in front of her, wiped her hands with a hot towel, and sat on the bed to eat breakfast.

    While she was eating, Xiao Hua reported today's plan beside her.

    "While you were sleeping, many express packages arrived. I have signed for them all and returned them to their places."

    "Among them, you purchased ten pieces of clothing, twenty pairs of cloth shoes from the Republic of China period, a box of silk thread, a box of pearls from the Merman Planet, and the cloud yarn you specially requested."

    "Has the courier from Shark Planet arrived?"

    Hua Qi suddenly raised her eyes, put down her burger, picked up the milk, drank it all, and hurried out of the bedroom to the living room.

    In a living room that is smaller than the living room outside, three large boxes are placed in the middle of the coffee table.

    Hua Qi opened the first foam box with excitement.

    Mainly white, supplemented by purple, and pink in the middle, a large box of pearls lies quietly in the box.

    Hua Qi's breath stagnated, and she casually picked up a string of white pearl necklaces. She felt the smooth feel and the size of her thumb, and was quite shocked.

    They have to be purchased from the country of origin, and the variety and quality are no less than those of the Australian white pearls on Blue Star.

    She only spent a few hundred interstellar coins on such a large box of pearls.

    If this were left in my hometown, a pearl would cost more than a few hundred dollars.

    Hua Qi gently put the pearl back into the box and looked at the other two boxes.

    The silk thread was a bit different from what she expected. It was not shiny and felt a bit rough, far from the smoothness of real silk.

    Although interstellar silkworm breeding methods are now very large-scale, every silkworm baby eats instant nutrient solution, and the silk they spit out is not very good.
